crime: For several weeks, a girl met {WITCH_NAME} beside the courtyard fountain at the start of evening free time. They walked one circuit of the courtyard and talked about the day.
Over the last few evenings, the girl began bringing another companion. The three walked together, but the girl spoke more to the newcomer than to {WITCH_NAME}.

On a clear evening, the girl and the companion found {WITCH_NAME} waiting at the fountain. The girl told the witch not to wait the next day; from then on, the girl and her new companion would take the walk together.
They immediately set out without {WITCH_NAME}. On the sunlit side of the fountain, the low evening sun cast the girl's long shadow across the rim.

The girl suddenly collapsed beside the companion. At first, it seemed that a sudden illness had killed the girl, but the prisoners found the girl's skull completely shattered beneath a scalp with no bruise, swelling, cut, or other sign of impact.

The companion had seen the shadow cast by the girl's head cross the rim and had watched the girl collapse without any object falling on the girl. The companion immediately ran back around the fountain and found {WITCH_NAME} rising from behind it with freshly split, bleeding knuckles.

Four fresh blood smears still marked the spot on the rim where the shadow of the girl's head had fallen, forming the print of a closed fist. The prisoners matched the four smears to the four fresh wounds on {WITCH_NAME}'s knuckles.
No blow had struck the girl's head. Hidden behind the fountain, {WITCH_NAME} had punched the part of the shadow corresponding to the girl's head, and Shadow Wound had shattered the girl's skull.
fields.epitaph: Her hands never closed. The hammer was the only thing that came back.
execution: An enormous pendulum hammer faced a tall target slab. She was fastened upright against the slab, both hands spread open beside her shoulders.
The hammer began its downswing. Her fingers strained but could not close before the hammer's head slammed into her chest and crushed her against the slab.

Her ribs and sternum collapsed, and her spine snapped against the slab. The hammer came to rest against her caved-in chest, leaving her corpse hanging from the restraints that still held both hands open.

magic.name: Shadow Wound
magic.text: She can injure a person by striking that person's shadow.
